help.scope: Determines which agents receive this server: all, only the orchestrator, or only the subagents.
help.command: Executable command of the local MCP server, e.g. npx or a path to a binary.
help.args: Arguments of the command — one argument per line.
help.env: Environment variables for the process — one KEY=VALUE per line.
help.url: Endpoint of the running MCP server, e.g. https://host/mcp.
help.headers: Optional HTTP headers — one Name: Value per line (e.g. Authorization: Bearer …).

help.profileName: Freely chosen name for this combination of workspace, orchestrator and subagents.
help.workingDir: Local repository or project folder the agents work in. The auto-PR base branch is derived from this folder's git origin when needed.
help.githubAuth: Browser OAuth (device flow with VERTRAGUS_GITHUB_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID) or gh --web. Tokens are stored encrypted locally, never in the profile or in logs. Required for auto PR.
help.generateFromRepo: The selected analysis model reads the working-directory repository read-only and proposes roles, models and quality gates. Depending on repo size this can take one to several minutes.
help.agentWorkingDir: Optional path for this slot only. Empty inherits the workspace base path.
help.mode: Orchestrated lets Claude or Codex plan and delegate. Single starts only the configured slots. Efficiency Solo starts exactly ONE agent that works directly — minimal fixed token cost, retro learnings in the prompt, only report_activity/record_retro as tools.
help.orchestratorProvider: Only providers with a verified Vertragus MCP adapter can orchestrate.
help.permissionMode: Auto mode approves edits automatically. Plan mode lets Claude plan only.
help.model: Empty uses the preset or CLI default. Free text overrides the preset. The list menu on the right lets you pick another model at any time — even when one is already set.
help.modelPreset: Capability preset (fast/balanced/strong). Applies only when the model is empty — free text takes precedence.
help.plannerMode: Auto starts valid plans immediately. Review waits for approval. Manual disables execute_plan.
help.routingMode: Adaptive starts only the orchestrator first and activates task agents to match the plan. Prewarmed starts all slots immediately.
help.maxParallel: Global upper limit of concurrently running plan tasks; role capacities can reduce it further.
help.maxRetries: How often the orchestrator may re-plan in a focused way after a failed plan without new user input.
help.multiAgent: Starts every instance of the chosen slot in parallel for each delegated task. A slot override takes precedence; "inherit global" adopts this global setting. The runtime still forms a candidate group only for orchestrated use with a count > 1, but stores the override regardless.
help.autoPrMode: PRs are created only after successful gates. Draft is the recommended safe starting mode.
help.prStrategy: Aggregate combines task commits into one goal PR. Per task creates separate PRs.
help.baseBranch: Target branch of the PR. Empty uses the bound default branch or the origin remote's.
help.qualityGates: Trusted shell commands that must succeed in the task and integration worktrees.
help.autoGitMode: After a fully successful workspace run, all changes in the workspace are committed and pushed to origin. On failure the run stays red.
help.autoGitBranch: Explicit target branch on origin. Options, ref specs, revisions, whitespace and control characters are rejected.
help.role: Distinct capability the planner addresses, e.g. frontend, backend, tests or review.
help.agentProvider: CLI that runs this slot. Login happens separately in the provider sidebar.
help.count: Maximum parallel task capacity of this role and the count for a manual team start.
help.yolo: Skips provider confirmations. Use only with worktree isolation and a deliberate scope.
help.orchestrated: When active, the orchestrator may delegate tasks to this slot.
help.skills: Named, reusable procedures of this workspace ("how we do X here"). They are injected into the orchestrator/solo prompts, and the orchestrator maintains them itself via the MCP tools list_skills/record_skill/remove_skill — the profile keeps learning across runs.
help.fallbackModels: Comma-separated model names this slot falls back to in order on a usage limit ("at capacity", 5h/weekly limit) — only afterwards does Vertragus switch providers.
help.strengths: Comma-separated capabilities the orchestrator should prefer when picking roles.
help.weaknesses: Comma-separated tasks the orchestrator should avoid assigning to this slot.
help.benchmark: Auto benchmark: the orchestrator gives all slots the same task, compares and scores the results, and stores the findings as model knowledge for future runs.
help.applyLearnings: Applies stored retro and benchmark findings matching provider and model to the slots' strengths/weaknesses. The findings are produced automatically after every run.
